notes.title: I returned to school! Ready to accelerate the persecution of school leaders
notes.content: [p]This school is at a below-average level in Shantou, but it will never fall to the very bottom.I remember the teacher mentioned the seniors in their final year, "Those who did not get in by their own efforts will at least cherish this opportunity" (Teacher Xiao), and "I have taught some of those final year students for a year; they are the group that changed from bad to good" (History Teacher).Undergraduate enrollment rate: Last year, 9 students were admitted to public undergraduate programs (source: History Teacher).You must understand that the oath made under that blood banner during the entrance ceremony carries a heavy burden, one that cannot be discharged in a lifetime! Only a public declaration of withdrawal can eliminate such a severe vow.Yi Kuan is utilizing Guo Zhiyuan to take action at Guiyu High School. The entire school has refused to issue diplomas, and reports have emerged to destroy Guiyu High School.Withdrawal phone number: +86 13433394440.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/7a095d55a80508b09bb43f24c16d7f05046be8ba.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/dd465d0a3781470e4828c9b08d98f954f3f446b9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/7e08e06c8ad0f893f1bc300e5ec9a2b18378fa71.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/0837189e3a9c9f7b9720028603a8117b8df37b70.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/0f2ddd0470703fd6b8a5cec9e708e99fbbb5fd11.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/53ed8d109cd5d2789bed17bf0c370a992204a978.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/c83f5658cc146ba0f34cfa67aeee2df939d4ab6e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/48b48df6e3958e5a01bf1d785c2af64525568386.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/6f2ddbd7f4c9581ca2badc92c3851e5b0b53e4a0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/1d2945be35d6e51744ffcd8988e234687e3162f0.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: senior high school
notes.content: [p]Answering some questions and rumors:[/p][p]1. Was I really expelled from school?[/p][p]Answer: No, my comprehensive quality evaluation still retains my student status, but the principal has already written a letter of expulsion, and I have already ruined the reputation of Guiyu Middle School on Douyin. It has reached a point where the situation is out of control, provided that I don’t release a clarification video.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/f469689ca45ec20fd0bb27fa191e5de6a7e69ac1.png"][/img][/p][p]2. Was I arrested by the police?[/p][p]Answer: Yes, I was sent to Yangpu Public Security Bureau for questioning because of my failed suicide attempt in Huangpu River. But after the police learned about my situation, they sent me back home and did not confiscate my computer or other things.[/p][p]3. Can I go back in my senior year of high school?[/p][p]Answer: I don’t know.[/p][p][/p][p]Update content:[/p][p]Updated to June 7th. The reason for my change of attitude was that two classmates took Spring Airlines to Shanghai to visit me from June 2nd to June 3rd.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44644541/8865a3cffbfd2691e791ab2e50c5726895fcde09.png"][/img][/p]
